metadata.description: Singapore places open 24 hours, grouped by type.
metadata.open_24h_rule: Included only when the API's regularOpeningHours reports a single period opening at day 0 / 00:00 with no close, or weekdayDescriptions all read "Open 24 hours". Places with no opening-hours data are excluded (non-invention).
metadata.non_invention: name / address / tel / google_maps_url are verbatim from the Places API response; missing values are null. Nothing is fabricated.
metadata.status: scaffold — empty until scripts/fetch-24hr-places.js is run with GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY set
